risk_if_not_implemented: Without Remote Purging, mobile and portable devices may expose organizational data through loss, theft, insecure configuration or unauthorized use. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Retention / Inability to Dispose of Data (R-AM-3), Delayed Containment / Increased Incident Impact (R-IR-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Utility Service Disruption (MT-7), Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Centralized Management Of Mobile Devices
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to implement and govern Mobile Device Management (MDM) controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Centralized Management Of Mobile Devices (MDM-02) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Remote Purging (MDM-09) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Identity & Access Management (IAM)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of Identification and Access Management (IAM) controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Identity & Access Management (IAM) (IAC-02) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Remote Purging (MDM-09) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
